verbProbe.note: MET means this probe ran a read-only call that the row names and the client answered it. NOT_SUPPORTED is a named declaration, never a measurement. NOT_PROBED is either a refusal this probe holds itself to or an answer that carries too little to be credited — `reason` says which and `attempted` says whether a call was made. No verb row climbs the seven-layer ladder: it can make a card honest, it cannot make a client MET above Installed.
